main_text.p: lis personis, nullaque re certa circumscripta revocet. Qua unam veram ac perfectam esse Iuris tractandi rationem, Antonius libro de Orat.II. his docet verbis: In quo etiã ifti nos Iurisconsulti impe-diunt, à discendoque deter-rent. Video enim in Catonis &Bruti libris nominatim se rè referri, quid alicui de iure viroaut mulieri respõderint. Credo, ut putaremus, in hominibus, non in re, consultationis aut dubitationis causam aliquam fuisse: ut quòd homines essent innumerabiles, debilitati à Iure cognoscē-do, voluntatem discendi, si-mul

page.notes: Right-edge « marks are printed quotation marks repeated at each line end, not transcribed as words. Stray marks at lower left ("-o") and centre-bottom ("(") and small specks are not printed text and are omitted. Running head reads "IVRISCONSVLTVS." and is given with u/v normalised. Ligature "ct" in "tractandi" and in the head of "tractandi" is transcribed from the scan with moderate confidence. Long s is rendered as plain s throughout.
